messages.subject: For Odile Renaud-Basso | Sustainable investment, government partnerships and emerging-market execution
messages.body:
Dear EBRD Communications Team,

Please place this executive introduction before President Odile Renaud-Basso.

EBRD's sustainable-investment mandate sits at the intersection of governments, private-sector execution, climate priorities and institutional reform. That environment aligns closely with my experience operating across corporate leadership, regulators and public institutions.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate cross-functional execution across complex regulated environments.

I would welcome a discussion about where this combination of government partnerships, sustainability and emerging-market operating experience might support EBRD's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to EBRD.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
